native_terminal_evidence.scope: Native exit metadata only; this does not attest to checker acceptance or model contents.

limitations: This review is packet readiness only. The prepared body has not been transmitted or run by this reviewer.

Native successful exit is captured, but terminal model/checkpoint integrity is not accepted until the B-side checker creates a valid VERIFICATION.json and root validates the verifier unit completion and outputs.
No model/checkpoint/data payload was read by this reviewer; no SSH, training, inference, grading, or GPU action was performed.
reviewed_properties: The packet pins raw launch, normalized launch acceptance, admission, split, source manifest, fit binding, checker, support module, preparation receipt, and captured native terminal evidence; the body rechecks exact digests before staging.

The output directory is create-only. Staged LAUNCH.json and TERMINAL_EVIDENCE.json are each written once; generated outputs use distinct VERIFIER_ADMISSION.json, VERIFIER_LAUNCH.json, VERIFICATION.json, and unit.log names.

The fresh native gate checks current invocation, active/exited state, exact successful integer exit fields, CPU usage, timestamps, and MemoryPeak. It also rechecks source inventory/content, split identity, registered paths, required terminal artifact stats, persistent output storage, parent occupancy, headroom, and free-space guards before launching the verifier.
The verifier unit is constrained to 50% CPU, 1.4 GB MemoryHigh, 1.5 GB MemoryMax, no swap, and 600 seconds; CUDA is hidden and CPU thread environment variables are set to one.

The admission body only stages code and JSON metadata and stats the model artifacts. The subsequent pinned checker is the component that performs bounded hashing and restricted CPU checkpoint loading.
scope: Independent static review of the frozen local generator and its prepared remote verifier body. No transmission or remote action was performed by this reviewer.
